whatIsThis.title: What is MatchOps?
whatIsThis.description: MatchOps is a match-day app for football and futsal coaches. Before the game you make the plan in the Match planner - who starts, who is in goal and when the changes come - for one game or a whole tournament day, and on match day you mark who is away. During the game the match clock, substitutions and goals are right there with you. After the game the Match sheet and Match report are ready to share, and statistics build up automatically at player, match, team and competition level. New coaches start in a lighter view, and one choice takes them to the full app.
whatIsThis.oneLine: Free with secure cloud sync across your devices. Track games and build statistics right at the field, even without internet.

whoIsThisFor.title: Who Is This For?
whoIsThisFor.description: MatchOps is for football and futsal coaches at every level - from junior teams to recreational and competitive sides - who want a simple way to run their matches and support their players' development, without complex team management software or monthly subscriptions.
whoIsThisFor.item3: Coaches who value privacy and own their data

challenges.title: Common Challenges for Coaches
challenges.challenge1: Juggling multiple tools on game day: clipboard, stopwatch, notebook, lineup sheet
challenges.challenge2: Tracking substitution intervals is tricky—you can't substitute until the game allows it, intervals stretch, and counting in your head takes focus away from what matters
challenges.challenge3: Coach must focus on the game, so most events go undocumented and are soon forgotten
challenges.challenge4: No easy way to look back at games or build statistics across a season
challenges.challenge5: Long-term decisions end up based on memory rather than actual data

faq.title: Common Questions
faq.q1: How do I install the app?
faq.a1: The app is currently in closed testing on Google Play. To join the testing group, contact us at hello@match-ops.com.
faq.a2: Your data is stored securely and stays private.
faq.q3: Can I use it on multiple devices?
faq.a3: Yes. You can export your data from one device and import it on another, or use cloud sync to keep devices in sync.
faq.q4: How do I back up my data?
faq.a4: Open the Settings menu and use the Export function. This creates a JSON file with all your data that you can save and import later.
faq.q5: Can I edit game data after it's recorded?
faq.a5: Yes. You can edit, add, or delete goal events and modify match details. Just open the game from your history and make corrections.
faq.q6: What happens if I lose my phone or it breaks?
faq.a6: If you've made regular exports (backups), you can import your data on a new device. Without backups, data is lost with the device.
faq.a7: Yes. You can create and manage multiple teams (U12, U14, etc.) from the same app and switch between them easily.
faq.q8: How much storage space does the app use?
faq.a8: The app uses your device's free storage space. Typical usage with 100+ games and full statistics is under 50MB.
faq.q9: How do I update the app?
faq.a9: The app updates automatically when you open it and have an internet connection. After an update, the app will notify you of the new version and ask you to reload the page.
faq.q10: Can I share statistics with other coaches?
faq.a10: Yes. You can export statistics in Excel or JSON format and share the files with other coaches via email or messaging apps.

plan.title: Plan
plan.desc: Build the starting line-up, positions and substitutions in advance in the Match planner – for one game or a whole tournament day. Before the game you mark who is away, and the plan adapts.

record.title: Record

descriptions.fieldDesc: Select and place players on an interactive soccer field. Visualize formations before the game.
descriptions.timerDesc: Game timer with substitution intervals. Log goals, assists, and events with a tap.
descriptions.statsDesc: Comprehensive player, team and competition statistics. Track performance across seasons.
descriptions.statsLongDesc: Every goal, assist, and game event builds your season statistics. Review game history and team statistics with comprehensive analytics.

attendance.title: Absences before kick-off
attendance.desc: Mark who is away on the Next match card opens a list with every player already ticked: tap the players who are away, and the top shows how many are here. The plan and the starting line-up fill in with the players who are there, and the changes you made to the plan are kept. An absent player is not in the match squad, so the game does not count as played for them. Before kick-off you also find the same screen in the match menu.

finish.title: Match sheet and match report, ready
finish.desc: When the game ends, Finish this game brings the result, the line-up and the goals together on one screen. The Match sheet is ready to copy: players with shirt numbers, goalkeeper and captain, final score, half-time score and every goal with its minute. In the Match report you write or dictate your own account from a ready template of headings, and Share match report sends the result, scorers, line-up and your report to the team.

planner.title: Plan several games at once
planner.desc: For a tournament day or a run of games: plan the starting line-ups and substitutions for several games at once. Each player's planned minutes and positions are colour-coded, so you see the spread at a glance. Adjust the plan mid-series and see how the changes affect the whole. A one-game plan is made in the same place, and a new game can be prefilled from a plan.

development.title: Track development over time
development.desc: After a game, note how each player is developing - strengths, growing areas, and the direction they're heading. Over time those notes build into an overall picture you can share as a summary.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.desc: Home has four tabs, and you can swipe between them. Games shows the next or the latest match, Club gathers players, teams and staff on the club card, Competitions shows the season record and the form of the last five games plus leagues and tournaments, and Stats shows wins-draws-losses, goal difference and the top scorers.

gameday.title: Track the whole game, live
gameday.desc: Place your lineup on the field, run the timer, and log goals, assists and substitutions as they happen - offline, right at the pitch.

stats.title: Stats that build themselves
stats.desc: Every game you track feeds season, player and team statistics automatically - no spreadsheets. See how the season's going, who's scoring, and how each player is used.

positionBalance.title: Positions played across the season
positionBalance.desc: Across a whole season, see which positions each player has actually played - by line or exact spot. Players kept in one role stand out, so you can deliberately broaden how each player is used.

nextMatch.title: Know when to leave
nextMatch.desc: The front page shows your next fixture: how many days away, kick-off, the venue and which pitch, and a button straight to driving directions. Set the place you leave from and how long before kick-off you want to be at the ground, and it works out your departure time - counting back through both, not just the drive. Give one match its own arrival time when a cup tie asks for more, or record how long the journey really took, and every later match at that venue uses the real figure.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy for MatchOps

dataController.title: Data Controller
dataController.content: MatchOps is developed and operated by Ville Pajala, based in Finland. We are the controller of your account data (your email, settings, consent records) and of the error reports and usage statistics described below. For the personal data you enter about other people (players, staff), you - or the club you act for - are the controller and we act as your processor (see Data Processing in the Terms of Service).

overview.title: Overview
overview.content: MatchOps ("we", "our", "the app") is a soccer coaching application that uses secure cloud sync. This privacy policy explains how we handle your information.

dataStorage.title: Data Storage
dataStorage.localDataIntro: Your data is also stored on your device for offline use, including:

localDataItems.personnelInfo: Personnel information (names, roles, contact details if you choose to enter them)

dataStorage.localDataNote: This on-device copy is protected by your device and is not directly accessible to us. The synced copy is stored in your private cloud account (see Cloud Sync below).
dataStorage.noAccountContent: Using the app requires creating an account and signing in. Providing your email address to create the account is necessary to deliver the app and its cloud sync, and the service cannot be provided without it. Any other personal data you enter (players, personnel, game records) is provided at your own discretion.
dataStorage.cloudDataIntro: Your data is stored on our secure cloud servers:

cloudDataItems.syncedData: Stored on Supabase servers in the EU (Stockholm, Sweden)
cloudDataItems.encryption: Encrypted in transit (HTTPS/TLS) and at rest
cloudDataItems.rowLevelSecurity: Protected by row-level security: through the app, each account can reach only its own data

dataStorage.cloudDataNote: Cloud data is stored in EU data centres (Stockholm, Sweden). You can delete your cloud data or your whole account at any time in Settings → Data.
dataStorage.dataRetentionContent: Your cloud data is kept while your account exists. When you delete your cloud data or your account (Settings → Data), it is removed from the live database immediately; any copy in our hosting provider's backups is removed when that backup expires (at most 30 days). Deleting your account also deletes your consent records. If an account is unused for a long time, we may delete its cloud data after notifying you first. Data on your device stays there until you delete it or clear the app's storage. Error reports are deleted by Sentry automatically within at most 90 days.
dataStorage.operatorAccess: Who can see your data: you. As the operator we technically have administrator access to the database, but we do not look at your content. We access it only when you ask us to (for example to solve a problem you report) or when the law requires it.

legalBasis.title: Legal Basis for Data Processing (GDPR Art. 6)
legalBasis.intro: We process personal data on the following legal bases:
legalBasis.contract: Contract (Art. 6(1)(b)): providing the service you signed up for - your account and email address, storing and syncing your data, and the account emails the service needs (sign-up confirmation, password reset).
legalBasis.consent: Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)): only for marketing emails (see Marketing Emails) and for connecting your own AI provider (see Voice Notes and Optional AI). You can withdraw consent at any time; withdrawal does not affect earlier processing.
legalBasis.legitimateInterest: Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)): error reporting via Sentry to find and fix bugs, and onboarding milestones to improve how new coaches get started - both can be turned off in Settings → Data → Error reporting and usage statistics. Keeping the record of your acceptance of the Terms of Service and this Privacy Policy is also based on our legitimate interest in being able to demonstrate it (accountability, Art. 5(2)). None of this involves profiling or tracking, and we make no automated decisions about you.

dataWeCollect.title: Data We May Collect
dataWeCollect.errorReportingIntro: Unless you turn it off, Sentry receives the following from the app:

errorReportingItems.errorType: When an error happens: the error type and stack trace
errorReportingItems.deviceType: Device type, browser and operating system version
errorReportingItems.sessionInfo: A pseudonymous session identifier, not linked to your account or email
errorReportingItems.replay: When an error happens: a replay of the screen in the moments before it, with all text and images masked
errorReportingItems.performance: Performance traces for a sample of page loads and screen changes (about 1 in 10): timings and the app address visited

dataWeCollect.errorReportingNote: This is pseudonymous data, not anonymous. We use it only to find and fix bugs and keep the app fast. Reports are built to leave out your game data and player information: text and images are masked in replays, and keys and sign-in data are scrubbed before sending. Sentry processes it in the US under Standard Contractual Clauses. You can turn this off at any time in Settings → Data → Error reporting and usage statistics; from then on the app sends Sentry nothing for your account.
dataWeCollect.licenseValidationContent: If paid features are introduced, Google Play will handle all payment processing. We verify license status through Play Store API but do not receive your payment information.
dataWeCollect.consentTrackingIntro: When you accept the Terms of Service and this Privacy Policy, or grant or withdraw marketing consent, we record:

consentTrackingItems.policyVersion: Which policy version was in force
consentTrackingItems.consentType: What you accepted, granted or withdrew (terms and privacy, or marketing emails)

dataWeCollect.consentTrackingNote: We keep these records to be able to demonstrate your acceptance and your marketing choices (GDPR Art. 5(2) and 7(1)) while your account exists. They are deleted together with your account and are included in your data export.
dataWeCollect.personnelDataIntro: When you add team personnel (coaches, assistants, medical staff), you may optionally enter:
dataWeCollect.personnelDataNote: This data is stored on your device and synced to your cloud account in the EU (Stockholm, Sweden). Staff contact details (email, phone) are personal data under GDPR. For any personal data you enter about other people (such as players and staff), you - or the club you act for - are the controller and are responsible for having a lawful basis to store it and for informing the people concerned; we process it only on your behalf (see Data Processing in the Terms of Service).
dataWeCollect.onboardingContent: Unless you turn it off, we store a few timestamps about your onboarding progress (account created, setup finished or skipped, first plan seen, first and second match finished) in your account settings, together with your chosen layout (Basic or Full). We use the timestamps only to improve how new coaches get started. They contain none of your game data, are never shared or sold, and are deleted with your account. To object, turn off Settings → Data → Error reporting and usage statistics: no further timestamps are then recorded. The layout is a setting of the app and is always kept.

dataWeDoNotCollect.title: What We Do Not Do With Your Data

items.gameContent: Your games, scores and statistics: we store them only to provide the app and its sync. We never use, analyse, share or sell them.
items.location: Your device's location: the app never reads it (no GPS). Places you choose to save - match venues and your team's starting point, with their address and map pin - are stored as part of your data to show travel and departure times. Searching for a place sends the text you type to Photon (see Third-Party Services and Recipients).
items.photos: Photos or media: the app does not collect them.
items.deviceIds: Tracking or advertising: the app has no ads and no advertising or analytics trackers, and uses no device identifiers for them.
items.playerNames: Player names, notes and other details about people: the same - stored only to provide the sync, never used, analysed, shared or sold.

dataWeDoNotCollect.personnelNote: Note: staff contact details (email, phone) you enter are stored by your choice and under your control - see Personnel Data above.

thirdPartyServices.title: Third-Party Services and Recipients
thirdPartyServices.intro: Supabase, Sentry, Resend and Vercel are our sub-processors; data processing agreements are in place with each of them. Google Play, Photon, palloliitto.fi and an AI provider you connect are not our sub-processors: they receive data directly from your device, only when you use them, under their own terms.
thirdPartyServices.sentryDesc: Error reporting, error replays and performance traces, unless you turn them off (US, Standard Contractual Clauses).
thirdPartyServices.supabaseDesc: Cloud database and authentication, hosted in the EU (Stockholm, Sweden).
thirdPartyServices.vercelDesc: Hosting of the app and the website. Like any web host it processes your IP address in its request logs (global edge network, Standard Contractual Clauses).
thirdPartyServices.photonDesc: Place search in the match venue field and the starting-point field (Settings), when used. It receives the text you type, not your location (EU, Germany).
thirdPartyServices.openai: OpenAI, or the AI provider you connect
thirdPartyServices.openaiDesc: Only if you connect your own account: the voice notes and text you choose to send go to that provider under your own key. We hold no key and see no content (see Voice notes and AI).
thirdPartyServices.palloliittoDesc: The rulebook PDF is fetched from their site when you open a law; they see the request as they would any website visit (IP address), nothing else.
thirdPartyServices.resendDesc: Sends the account emails (sign-up confirmation, password reset) from noreply@auth.match-ops.com and, if you opt in, marketing emails. It receives your email address and the message (may be processed in the US under Standard Contractual Clauses).

yourRights.title: Your Rights (GDPR)
yourRights.intro: Under GDPR and applicable data protection laws, you have the right to:
yourRights.access: Access (Art. 15): export all your data at any time in Settings → Data → Backup & Export - your games, players, staff, settings, your account email and your consent records
yourRights.rectification: Rectification (Art. 16): correct your data directly in the app
yourRights.erasure: Erasure (Art. 17): delete the data on your device, your cloud data or your whole account at any time in Settings → Data
yourRights.portability: Portability (Art. 20): the export is a standard JSON file you can take elsewhere
yourRights.restriction: Restriction (Art. 18): ask us to limit how we process your data by emailing support@match-ops.com
yourRights.objection: Objection (Art. 21): turn off Settings → Data → Error reporting and usage statistics - error reports and onboarding milestones then stop for your account. For any other objection, email support@match-ops.com
yourRights.withdrawConsent: Withdraw consent (Art. 7(3)): withdraw marketing consent in Settings → Account → Email Preferences, and disconnect an AI provider in Settings at any time
yourRights.deleteLocal: Data on this device: Settings → Data
yourRights.deleteCloud: Cloud data and your account: Settings → Data
yourRights.contactUs: Most rights can be used directly in the app under Settings → Data. For anything else, email support@match-ops.com.
yourRights.supervisoryAuthority: If you believe your data protection rights have been violated, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. In Finland: Office of the Data Protection Ombudsman (Tietosuojavaltuutetun toimisto)

childrensPrivacy.title: Children's Privacy
childrensPrivacy.content: MatchOps is a tool for adult coaches, not for children. Players do not use the app: the coach enters player names, statistics and notes. That data is stored on the coach's device and in the coach's cloud account in the EU only to provide the service, and we never send it to third parties other than our sub-processors listed above - except when the coach connects their own AI provider and chooses to send notes or recordings to it (see Voice Notes and Optional AI). The coach, or the club the coach acts for, is the controller of the player data and is responsible for informing players' families; Settings → Data has a ready-made notice for that.

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.localIntro: On your device, your data is stored in the browser's IndexedDB database:

localItems.deviceProtection: Protected by your device's access controls (screen lock, password, biometrics)
localItems.noAdditionalEncryption: Not additionally encrypted at rest beyond what your device/browser provides
localItems.noTransmission: The on-device copy is only transmitted when syncing to your private cloud account, over an encrypted connection

dataSecurity.localNote: Your device's security is your primary protection for local data. We recommend using a strong screen lock.

cloudItems.rowLevelSecurity: Row-level security ensuring you can only access your own data
cloudItems.soc2: Backed by Supabase's security infrastructure and SOC 2 compliance

dataSecurity.backupContent: When you export your data, the file contains all of it, including staff contact details, your account email and your consent records. Export files are not encrypted, so store them somewhere safe and delete copies you no longer need.

voiceNotesAndAi.title: Voice Notes and Optional AI
voiceNotesAndAi.intro: MatchOps can record short voice notes during a game. This is how they are handled:

items.onDevice: Recordings are stored only on your device. They are never uploaded to MatchOps servers, never synced between devices, and never included in backups or exports.
items.deleted: A recording is deleted from your device as soon as you turn it into a note or discard it, and in any case after 30 days.
items.notes: The written notes you save become part of the game record and are handled like all other game data described above (stored on your device and, in cloud mode, synced to your account).
items.neverReceived: MatchOps never receives your recordings. Notes and report text you choose to save are game data and are handled as described above.

voiceNotesAndAi.aiIntro: You may connect your own account with an AI provider (for example OpenAI) to transcribe recordings, draft or tidy match reports, translate a report, and read back your own notes about one player as prose. If you do:

aiItems.yourAccount: Data is sent directly from your device to the provider you chose, under your own account and your own API key. MatchOps is not a party to that processing and has no access to it.
aiItems.onlyOnAction: Nothing is sent automatically. Data leaves your device only when you press a button that says so (Transcribe, Draft, Tidy, Translate, Group these notes), and the app tells you what it is about to send first.
aiItems.providerTerms: The provider processes and retains data under its own terms, which you accepted when you created the account. MatchOps has no control over that retention.
aiItems.pseudonymized: Before drafting requests, player names are replaced with codes on your device (on by default). Transcription requests necessarily contain the words you spoke.
aiItems.disconnect: You can disconnect the provider and delete all recordings at any time from Settings. The key is stored only on your device.

marketing.title: Marketing Emails
marketing.content: Only if you opt in, we send occasional emails about new features and tips to your account email. The legal basis is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a)). You can withdraw it at any time in Settings → Account → Email Preferences; each grant and withdrawal is recorded (see Consent Records). The emails are sent through Resend. Without your consent we send only the account emails the service needs (sign-up confirmation, password reset).

dataProcessing.title: Data Processing (GDPR Art. 28)
dataProcessing.intro: This section is the data processing agreement between you and us under GDPR Art. 28(3). It is based on the standard contractual clauses between controllers and processors adopted by the European Commission in Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/915, and it applies whenever you enter personal data about other people (players and staff).

items.roles: Roles: you - or the club you act for - are the controller of that data. MatchOps (Ville Pajala) is your processor.
items.scope: Subject, nature and duration: storing, syncing and showing the data you enter (such as names, shirt numbers, positions, match events, statistics, notes and staff contact details) about the players and staff of your teams, for as long as your account exists.
items.instructions: Instructions: we process the data only to provide the service, on your documented instructions - these Terms and the actions you take in the app - unless EU or Finnish law requires otherwise; in that case we tell you first, unless the law forbids it.
items.confidentiality: Confidentiality: everyone authorised to process the data on our behalf is bound by confidentiality. We do not look at your content except when you ask us to or the law requires it.
items.security: Security (Art. 32): the data is hosted in the EU (Stockholm, Sweden), encrypted in transit (HTTPS/TLS) and at rest, and separated per account by row-level security. If a personal data breach affects your data, we notify you without undue delay.
items.subprocessors: Sub-processors: you give general authorisation for Supabase (database and authentication, EU), Sentry (error reporting), Resend (account emails) and Vercel (hosting). We bind them by contract to the same data protection obligations. We tell you about any intended addition or replacement in advance by updating this list and the Privacy Policy, so you can object; if you object, you can stop using the service and delete your account.
items.assistance: Assistance: the app lets you access, correct, export and delete the data yourself, which is how we help you answer requests from the people concerned. As far as the nature of the processing allows, we also help you with security, breach notification and impact assessments.
items.deletion: End of the service: when you delete your account, we delete the data (see the Privacy Policy for backups). You can export it at any time before that.
items.compliance: Demonstrating compliance: on request to support@match-ops.com, we make available the information needed to demonstrate that these obligations are met, and allow and contribute to reasonable audits.

playerData.title: Player Data: Your Responsibilities
playerData.informFamilies: Informing players and their families about the data you keep (GDPR Art. 13-14) is your duty, or your club's. Settings → Data has a ready-made notice you can copy and send.
playerData.noSpecialCategories: Do not enter health data or other special categories of personal data (GDPR Art. 9) - for example injuries, illnesses, diagnoses, religion or ethnic origin - in notes, match reports or any other field. A first name or nickname is enough to identify a player.

deleteAccount.title: Delete Your Account and Data
deleteAccount.intro: You can permanently delete your MatchOps account and all associated data at any time. Here's how.
deleteAccount.step1: Open MatchOps and sign in to your account.
deleteAccount.step2: Go to Settings → Data → Delete Account.
deleteAccount.inAppNote: This permanently removes your account and all your data from our servers, and the copy cached on that device. It cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.whatContent: Your account and all data associated with it — players, teams, games, seasons, tournaments, personnel, settings and your consent records (including marketing choices) — both in the cloud and cached on your device. Any copy in our hosting provider's backups is removed when that backup expires (at most 30 days).
deleteAccount.keepContent: Before deleting, you can export a full backup from Settings → Backup. You can restore it later on another device or after creating a new account.
deleteAccount.cantAccessContent: If you can no longer open the app (for example, you uninstalled it), email us from the address associated with your account and we will delete your account and data for you.
deleteAccount.timelineContent: In-app deletion is immediate. Email requests are processed within 30 days.
